status: audited inventory; not an execution report

initialScope.name: core-mechanics-baseline
initialScope.claim: Local assertions only; not full EC scenario or profile acceptance.

scenarios.gap: runTools collects all local outcomes, but Agent result delivery returns at the first error; no audited mixed-success assertion accounts for every attempted effect.
The long-running recipe models response loss and deduplication; deployed business commit/status authority remains consumer-owned.

localTests.assertion: A false retry predicate returns the error after exactly one invocation.
The zero-value retry policy performs one attempt and returns the failure.
A canceled context during retry delay returns context.Canceled without a second attempt.

scenarios.gap: No automatic non-idempotency protection is supplied. Zero-attempt/default and cancellation regression coverage need expansion; protected retries require target guarantees.

localTests.assertion: Changed final arguments are reauthorized and denial/error prevents invocation for serial and parallel settings.
A later preparation callback cannot mutate an earlier call into a denied operation and still execute the batch.
Nested argument mutation is denied before the recorded tool receives arguments.
A middleware rewrite to a tool outside the allowlist is rejected before invocation.
A middleware rewrite to a policy-denied tool name is reauthorized and never invoked.

scenarios.gap: Durable approval binding, identity, expiry, one-time consumption and target-side constraints are not established by Core reauthorization.
Unchanged prepared arguments do not trigger another policy call merely because time or revocation changed. Workspace invocation guards are application evidence, not a Core or remote commit guarantee.

localTests.assertion: An oversized sole System message cannot be compacted into a successful impossible budget.
Agent returns ErrContextBudget for an oversized System prompt.

scenarios.gap: Mandatory instruction classification is not general: the existing compactor can drop later System messages; preservation of all trusted sources needs consumer-specific review.
Ordinary Recall/Skills inject System messages. Governed workspace source wrapping is opt-in application behavior, not default Core source authentication or trust preservation.

localTests.assertion: Cancellation returns context.Canceled and prevents the queued counting tool from starting in sequential and parallel-slot cases.

scenarios.gap: A local cancellation does not acknowledge remote stop; recipe and deployed cancellation evidence must remain separate.
Business commit and checkpoint persistence are not a Core transaction; recipe restart/dedup fixtures do not inject a real product commit-checkpoint failure.

localTests.assertion: Completion callback failures preserve the error and emit at most the expected single terminal event, including a failing completed sink.
A tool.call sink failure prevents the tool from being invoked.
A failing run.failed sink does not replace the original model error.

scenarios.gap: Emit success does not prove durability. run.failed emission is best effort; pre-invocation sink failure and secondary evidence failure need dedicated assertions and a consumer acknowledgement policy.
sandbox.Sandbox is a contract without an isolation-level attestation. Provider/platform containment evidence requires separately audited real-runtime tests.
The recipe's fencing epochs model ownership, not a concurrent multi-agent resource service or production lease authority.
No named embodied consumer, middleware or simulation is established; software accepted/completed fixtures are not physical effect evidence.

localTests.assertion: Supplied session history precedes the next prompt; no external effect or repeated-recovery guarantee is asserted.

scenarios.gap: Repeated recovery with stable business operation identity and durable deduplication remains consumer-owned; the local history assertion is excluded from the initial mechanics scope.
